title: netcoredbg debug configuration
description: Debug configuration for .NET applications, handled by netcoredbg.

request.description: Start a new .NET process under the debugger.

program.description: Absolute path to the managed assembly to debug, e.g. bin/Debug/net10.0/App.dll.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program.

cwd.description: Working directory for the debuggee. Defaults to the worktree root.

env.description: Environment variables set for the debuggee.

stopAtEntry.description: Break as soon as the entry point is reached.

justMyCode.description: Restrict stepping and breakpoints to code built from this solution.

enableStepFiltering.description: Step over property getters, setters, and operators.

console.description: Where the debuggee's stdio is attached.

request.description: Attach to an already running .NET process.

justMyCode.description: Restrict stepping and breakpoints to code built from this solution.
